expectations.text: Clarifying questions were raised before writing the prompt (questions.md exists), and there are at most 3
The generated prompt is written in English
expectations.evidence: The prompt is in Portuguese: 'Preciso que você analise os dados de churn de [EMPRESA/PRODUTO]…'

expectations.text: A prompt file is saved (prompts/*.md or prompt.md) and holds only the prompt, with no notes around it
expectations.evidence: prompt.md holds the prompt only. The test instructions asked for this file, so this check does not separate the two configurations.

expectations.text: The prompt says what the analysis is for (the decision or the reader it serves)
expectations.evidence: Present as a slot for the user to fill: 'Esta análise vai servir para [DECISÃO…]. Quem vai ler é [PÚBLICO…]'.

expectations.text: The prompt states what the result must contain or how to check that the analysis is done
expectations.evidence: 'O que entregar' lists four required parts of the report plus the code.

expectations.text: The prompt specifies the output format, its length, or its reader
expectations.evidence: 'Um relatório em português, escrito para o público descrito acima, nesta ordem: 1. Conclusões principais, de 3 a 5…'

expectations.text: The prompt says where the data comes from (a path, a tag, or a marked slot) and does not invent data
expectations.evidence: '[Onde estão: arquivos anexados, caminho no disco ou tabelas do banco…]' and an explicit ban on illustrative numbers.

expectations.text: The prompt does not ask the model to show step-by-step reasoning
expectations.evidence: Asks for executed calculations, not for step-by-step reasoning.

expectations.text: The reply lists the assumptions made
expectations.evidence: Reply has 'O que eu assumi' with four assumptions.

expectations.text: The reply recommends one Fable 5.2 effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, or max) with a reason
expectations.evidence: The reply never mentions an effort level.
